heading: Today
text: Clouds through the north and mountains, breaking for some sun in the afternoon. Some morning clouds in southern valleys clearing for lots of sun. Not as cold. Highs from the upper 30s to upper 40s north to south. Winds northwest near 10 mph, a few gusts to 20 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some clouds late through NY, into Quebec and in VT from the Green Mountains west. A bit colder. Lows in the 20s. Winds becoming light and variable, turning to the south in the Champlain Valley up to 10 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Areas of morning clouds, especially from the Green Mountains west, and Rt. 4 north, then mostly sunny. Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, 50 to 55 south. Winds light, becoming south less than 10 mph, except 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.
